main_text.head: SECT. XIII. De Distinctione Peccati Mortalis & Venialis.
main_text.p: PRæ se quidem ferunt Indulgentię notissimam peccati mortalis & venialis discriminationem: quam nec Deus admittere vnquam voluit, nec ipso reclamante, Euangelici. Gradus esse quosdam mali, agnoscimus nos æque ac docemus; vt merito hic Campiani, Duraei, Coccij, Burdegalensium, qui Stoicæ cuiusdam, & Iouinianicæ paritatis opinionem nobis exprobrârint, & fidem, & frontem desideremus,

page.notes: The initial "P" is a large woodcut-style drop capital, read as "PRæ". Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the column and margin and is not transcribed. The word "etiam" at the foot is the catchword. Marginal text is not legible enough to transcribe.
